messages.commands: 📚 Firewall Command Reference Use ! or . prefix for commands. 👤 User Moderation !ban [hours] — Ban user (reply) !mute [hours] — Mute user (reply) !unmute — Unmute user (reply) !reset — Reset warnings (reply) 🔒 Content Locks !lock [type] — Lock content type !unlock [type] — Unlock content type Types: link, url, photo, video, sticker, voice, file, gif, poll, forward, emoji, hashtag, mention, game, bot 📝 Word Filter !filter [word] — Add to blacklist !unfilter [word] — Remove from blacklist !filters — Show filter list 🌙 Quiet Hours !silence1 from HH:MM to HH:MM !silence1 off — Disable ⚙️ Settings !welcome on/off !warning on/off !autodelete on/off !joinleave on/off 🛡️ Group Control !lockgroup — Emergency lock !unlockgroup — Unlock group !purge [count] — Delete messages 📊 Limits !msglimit [count] — Rate limit !duplicate [count] — Anti-spam 👥 Whitelist !whitelist — Add user (reply) !unwhitelist — Remove (reply) 💡 Tip: Use Mini App for visual controls!
